newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Petron to raise pump prices on April 11.
newsitem.headline: Petron to raise pump prices on April 11.

text.p: Oil refiner Petron Corp said on Wednesday it plans to increase on April 11 the domestic pump prices of its petroleum products.

In a statement, Petron said the retail price of premium gasoline would be raised by 40 centavos to 11.67 pesos per litre, while unleaded premium would be increased by 40 centavos to 11.28 pesos per litre.
The pump price of regular gasoline would be adjusted 20 centavos upward to 10.39 pesos per litre, while diesel would be up 10 centavos to 7.7 pesos.
Kerosene, however, would be lowered to 6.83 pesos per litre, down 28 centavos from last month's level.
The wholesale price of premium gasoline would also be raised to 10.9336 pesos per litre and unleaded premium would go up to 10.5398 pesos per litre.
The price increases came a month after oil companies announced sharp price reductions following the full deregulation of the domestic oil industry.

Other oil companies -- Caltex (Philippines) Inc, a joint venture of Texaco Inc and Chevron Corp, and Pilipinas Shell Petroleum Corp, a unit of Royal Dutch/Shell Group -- are expected to announce their new prices in the coming days.
